concrete_editorial_additions.section: Separate chapter: The Monument to Independence as public infrastructure
concrete_editorial_additions.text: Explain that the 1910 column underwent an unsuccessful foundation phase and later post-1957 steel reinforcement; make visitors distinguish 1910 sculpture iconography from structural fabric altered after 1957.
Present the Templo Mayor's 1978 rediscovery and the Independence Column's 1902–1910 construction as distinct urban-history episodes rather than a single archaeological sequence.
